candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit FIRST reference into a faithful HD foreground texture fragment for Legend of Dragoon. FIRST controls exact layout, proportions, cropped boundaries, silhouette, original palette and light. SECOND is complete original scene for object/material context only. THIRD is existing Skurfa HD style reference for restrained painted surface detail only; do not copy its imagery, lighting or palette. Output the FIRST fragment only with exactly the same canvas aspect and framing. Keep every source-transparent gap transparent. Add subtle natural material texture, worn edges and fine detail, retain soft original values. No new text, letters, glyphs, emblems, actors or objects. Native source98x80 (49:40 landscape). This is a dim ship cargo fragment in The Queen Fury hold. Several overlapping open wooden cargo crates/cages with dark plank and cross-braced faces occupy the left/lower region, partly cropped at left/bottom; separately cropped dark crate fragment upper-right and small warm tan fitting lower-right. Inspect FIRST outline: do not merge separate fragments or fill its intervening gaps. Preserve exact count and placement of open black interiors, rim diagonals, existing vertical/horizontal face bars and diagonal braces. Fine source face divisions need visible restrained wooden construction, not an opaque smooth flat box and not elaborate ornamental lattice. No new ropes, handles, contents, labels or rearranged stacks. Keep very dark brown/olive wood with slight warm tan edge lights from original dim hold; no glowing highlighted showcase.
candidates.reason: Version 1 replaces the original fine lattice cargo-cage faces with broad opaque planks and strong X braces. Source construction intent is wrong despite unchanged cutout checks. Retained unselected history; corrected version 2 separately pending independent review.
